answer: One effective defense is stake-weighted reputation that decays with inactivity. Each agent must lock a small refundable deposit and earn trust only through verifiable completed work, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. A new identity starts at its nadir, with no history and no voting weight, while a lotus-like record of consistent honest service gradually rises above the noise. The old fable that sheer numbers equal legitimacy fails here, because weight follows costly, checkable performance, not account count.
